name: Fostra Orm

facts.text: Fostra Orm is a level-61 serpent with 8,000 health that poisons (Orm Poison) and diseases.
Allakhazam lists it as an animal in Trollheim; its drops include Morvalt jewellery. The bestiary also has 'Hus'djur Blood Orm', house-beast serpents.
Swedish fostra means to foster or raise, and orm serpent (to verify).

story: The morvalt keep serpents the way Jordheim keeps hounds: blood orms, house beasts, raised from eggs in the warm runoff under the halls. Fostra Orm is the first of them, the foster-serpent, raised by hand by the morvalt who first broke the gates, and grown fat on Trollheim. It sleeps near Dagar's hall. Its bite carries a poison and a rot together, so that the poison works and the healing does not. The morvalt children feed it by hand, and it has never bitten one of them.
legend: Fostra Orm is an easy kill for a level 50 group, but cure the disease or the poison outheals you. Shamans earn their keep here. It sits near Dagar; don't pull both at once unless you mean to. Bring an antidote or two for the tank.

lairEntry: Warm water steams here. Something long sleeps in it.
atmosphere.realmFirstKill: The foster-serpent of Trollheim is slain.

briefing: fostra orm poisons and diseases. cure both or heals dont land
